key.name: org-indent-mode
key.description: Visually indent sections by heading depth and hide extra heading stars without modifying file contents.

key.name: zoom
key.description: Font size of the editor text, in percent of the default size.

key.name: agenda-directory
key.description: Folder whose .org files (including subfolders) are shown in the agenda. A leading ~ is expanded to the home folder.
